source_id.description: Unique identifier for the source, e.g., SRC-001

url.description: Direct canonical URL of the source

title.description: Title or headline of the source material

author.description: Author, organization, or user who produced the content

published_at.description: Original publication date in ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD

retrieved_at.description: Timestamp when this evidence was collected

source_type.description: Format/platform: reddit, forum, review, industry_report, academic, documentation, interview, news

source_tier.description: Tier 1: primary/official/academic; Tier 2: reputable industry/journalism; Tier 3: credible secondary; Tier 4: community discussion; Tier 5: unattributed/SEO content

relevance.description: Why this source matters to the investigated problem

key_finding.description: Precise factual finding or verifiable observation extracted from the source

evidence_status.description: Verification status determined by Source Auditor

supports_claims.description: Specific claim IDs or statements directly supported by this source

corroborated_by.description: List of independent source IDs that substantiate the same claim

confidence.description: Epistemic confidence score (0-100) based on independence and source reliability
